int_name: N AMERICAN ST & W HUNTINGDON ST

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide vegetated median with a large concrete refuge island and marked zebra crosswalks. While the infrastructure provides a safe waiting area, the crossing is unsignalized across multiple lanes of traffic in a commercial area.

hazards.name: Unsignalized Multi-lane Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without the protection of a signal, relying on driver yielding behavior.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-actuated flashing lights to increase driver awareness and yielding rates at the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks and curb ramps, but lacks active traffic control or pedestrian signals. The wide roadway and industrial land use suggest a high-speed environment with significant crossing distances for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible for the primary direction of travel, which may encourage high vehicle speeds through the pedestrian crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to reduce crossing distance and allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Signage
interventions.description: Add pedestrian crossing warning signs (W11-2) to alert drivers to the presence of the crosswalk.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and a green-painted bike lane, indicating some prioritization of non-motorized transport. However, the crossing distance is relatively wide without a central refuge, and the lack of visible pedestrian signals may increase risk at this complex junction.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Wide turning radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry may encourage higher vehicle speeds during turns into the cross street.
hazards.location_in_image: Far right corner of the intersection

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Provide a protected space in the center of the roadway for pedestrians to wait, breaking up the crossing.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and curb ramps on all corners, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide roadway and lack of signalization or refuge islands increase exposure for pedestrians in an industrial-commercial setting.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the intersection increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicular traffic without a refuge.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Overgrown vegetation on the northwest corner may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Utility poles are placed within the sidewalk path, potentially narrowing the effective width for mobility device users.
hazards.location_in_image: Sidewalks on the left and right sides

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Clear vegetation and restrict parking near the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all users.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalks
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalks to the level of the sidewalk to slow turning vehicles and increase pedestrian visibility.
